# Slider

**Figma:** Slider/Horizontal, .Primitives/Slider/Slide-Dot (page 1556:17601)  
**Import:** `import { Slider } from "@zen/design-system";`

Pick a value from a continuous or stepped range by dragging, where the relative position matters more than the exact number.

## Use it for
- Volume, brightness, zoom, size — values users tune by feel.
- Stepped quantities with visible limits (storage 10–500 GB).
- White theme on imagery and media controls.

## Use something else for
- Exact numbers users type → NumberField.
- A handful of discrete options → Segmented or RadioButton.
- On/off → Toggle.

## Figma → React
| Figma | Prop | Values / notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Theme | `theme` | neutral · accent · white (Medium/Large only) |
| Size | `size` | small (10px rail, floating 16px dot) · medium (24) · large (32) |
| Value | `value / defaultValue / onValueChange · min · max · step` | native range input underneath |
| Icon | `icon` | leading icon inside the fill (Medium/Large); false hides it |
| Limits | `showLimits` | min/max labels (Caption/Regular) |
| Disabled | `disabled` | Solid-Disabled fill |

## Props
Generated from the TypeScript source; full JSON in `docs/api/slider.json`.

### Slider
Figma Slider/Horizontal (4010:35946): a rounded Neutral/Subtle rail with a filled track inset 1px that ends at the thumb (.Primitives/Slider/Slide-Dot). A native range input on top provides keyboard, pointer and screen-reader support.

| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `number` | — |  |
| `defaultValue` | `number` | `50` |  |
| `onValueChange` | `(value: number) => void` | — | Called with the new value while the thumb moves. |
| `onChange` | `(value: number) => void` | — | **Deprecated:** Use onValueChange (same arguments).  |
| `min` | `number` | `0` |  |
| `max` | `number` | `100` |  |
| `step` | `number` | `1` |  |
| `theme` | `"neutral" \| "accent" \| "white"` | `"neutral"` | Figma Theme: Neutral · Accent · White (White has Medium/Large only). |
| `size` | `"sm" \| "md" \| "lg" \| "small" \| "medium" \| "large"` | `"md"` | Figma Size: Small (10px rail, floating 16px dot) · Medium (24px) · Large (32px). Short (sm, md…) or Figma (small, medium…) spelling. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `icon` | `IconName \| ReactElement \| false` | `"icon-star-93-solid"` | Figma Icon (Medium/Large): the leading icon inside the filled track — an icon name or an icon element; `false` hides it. |
| `showLimits` | `boolean` | `false` | Figma Value: the min/max labels under the rail. |

## Keyboard
| Keys | Action |
| --- | --- |
| ← / → or ↓ / ↑ | Decrease / increase by one step |
| Page Up / Page Down | Larger step |
| Home / End | Minimum / maximum |

## ✅ Do
- Use a Solid icon for the leading Icon (it sits inside the filled track): icon-volume-max-solid, icon-sun-solid.
- Always name it (harness: slider/needs-name) and give valueText for units ("40%", "120 gigabytes").
- Show the current value next to the slider when the number matters.
- Use step for quantities with natural increments.
- Preview the effect live while dragging (volume, size).

## ❌ Don't
- Don't use White at Small — it doesn't exist (harness: slider/white-no-small).
- Don't use a slider for precise values without a way to type them.
- Don't put two sliders controlling the same value on one screen.

## Accessibility
- Native input type=range: ←/→/↑/↓ step, PageUp/PageDown, Home/End; focus ring on the dot; aria-valuetext from valueText.

## Content
- Label the setting ("Volume"), not the action ("Drag to change").

## Harness (`npm run usage:check`)
| Rule | Severity | Checks | Suppress with |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `slider/needs-name` | error | A Slider needs an accessible name (aria-label or aria-labelledby). | `zen-allow-slider-name: <reason>` |
| `slider/white-no-small` | error | Theme White exists in Medium and Large only (Figma); Small falls back to Neutral. | `zen-allow-white-small: <reason>` |
| `slider/solid-icon` | warn | The Slider leading icon uses the Solid style (it sits inside the filled track). | `zen-allow-slider-line-icon: <reason>` |
| `api/deprecated-prop` | warn | A deprecated prop still works but has a canonical name (onValueChange, onCheckedChange, checked, selected, level…); apps get a warning with the replacement. (App mode only; the repo migrates gradually.) | `zen-allow-deprecated: <reason>` |
| `icon/unknown-name` | error | Icon names must exist (1,598 names that follow the Figma layer path, e.g. icon-search-medium-line); search them instead of guessing (MCP search_icons, or the Iconography page). | `zen-allow-icon-name: <reason>` |
| `interaction/no-noop-handler` | warn | Every interaction a Zen control offers works: no no-op handlers (`() => {}`, `() => undefined`), which leave a field that ignores typing and ↑/↓ or a Dismiss that stays. Chat has chat/no-locked-interaction. | `zen-allow-noop-handler: <reason>` |
| `interaction/controlled-needs-handler` | warn | A controlled prop comes with its change handler (month + onMonthChange, value + onValueChange, open + onOpenChange, pageSize + onPageSizeChange…): without it nothing can change the value and the control is frozen, e.g. a DatePicker whose Previous/Next do nothing. Bare booleans (a fixed preview) and `x ? true : undefined` pins pass. | `zen-allow-controlled-handler: <reason>` |
